# Prepare

```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
from python_scripts import routes
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)
testing = False

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason", "dur"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

from IPython.display import Markdown

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}
dpw_pls_orig = dpw_pls
odds_r_tables = []
figure_major_i = 9
figure_minor_i = 0
# Alpha
alpha = 0.05

rt_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
rt_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in rt_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in rt_outcomes_map[outcome]}

```

## Sankey

```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import itertools
import random
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
from PIL import Image
sns.set()

for net_i, fig_i in zip(network_list, itertools.count(start=1)):
    fig_filename_svg = assets_output + f"Figure_15.{fig_i}.svg"
    fig_filename_png = assets_output + f"Figure_15.{fig_i}.png"
    if testing and Path(fig_filename_png).exists():
        net_i["svg"] = fig_filename_svg
        net_i["png"] = fig_filename_png
        continue
    n_cli = len(net_i["df"]["o_cli_id"].drop_duplicates())
    el = net_i["edge_list"][nt]
    end_cat_n = el[el["target"].isin(sorted_end_cats.keys())].groupby("target")[["n"]].sum().reset_index()
    end_cat_n["%"] = 100 * end_cat_n["n"]/end_cat_n["n"].sum()
    end_cat_repl = {"Independent accommodation": "Independent accom", "Insecure outcome": "Insecure", "Returned to homelessness": "Homelessness"}
    end_n = {k: v["str"] for k, v in
             end_cat_n[["target"]].join((end_cat_n["target"].replace(end_cat_repl)
                                         + ": " + end_cat_n["%"].apply("{:.0f}%".format)
                                         + " / " + end_cat_n["n"].apply("{:,}".format))
             .rename("str")).set_index("target").to_dict("index").items()}

    el["source"] = (el["source"].mask(el["source"].isin(["Known (adult pw)", "Known (other)", "New", "_RETURN"]),
                                      "Into " + el["target"].str.extract(r"^([A-Z/]+)", expand=False)))
    el = el[(~el["source"].isin(["EXTANT", "ENTRY"])) & (~el["target"].isin(["END", "RETURN"]))]
    el = el.groupby(["source", "target"]).sum().reset_index().drop(columns="weight")

    idx_node = { k: v for (k, v) in zip(itertools.count(), pd.concat([el["source"], el["target"]]).unique()) }
    node_idx = { v: k for (k, v) in idx_node.items() }

    el_idx = el.replace(node_idx)

    p_x = dict(f=0.5, m=3, mf=1.7, su=4.3)
    pos = {
    'F L1': (p_x["f"]-0.05, 1.475), 'F L2': (p_x["f"]+0.1, 2.475), 'F L3': (p_x["f"]+0.2, 3.475), 'F L4': (p_x["f"]+0.3, 4.475),
    'Into F': (1, 0.5), 'Into M': (3.2, 0.5), 'Into M/F': (1.9, 0.5), 'Into SU': (4.5, 0.5),
    'M L1': (p_x["m"], 1.475), 'M L2': (p_x["m"]+0.3, 2.475), 'M L3': (p_x["m"], 3.475), 'M L4': (p_x["m"]-0.2, 4.475),
    'M/F L1': (p_x["mf"], 1.525), 'M/F L2': (p_x["mf"], 2.525), 'M/F L3': (p_x["mf"], 3.525), 'M/F L4': (p_x["mf"]+0.05, 4.525),
    'SU L1': (p_x["su"], 2), 'SU L2': (p_x["su"]+0.25, 3),
    'Died': (4.9, 5.60), 'Independent accommodation': (0.6, 5.60), 'Insecure outcome': (1.9, 5.55),
    'Other': (4.45, 5.55), 'Returned to homelessness': (3.5, 5.60),
    }

    # Adjustments
    if net_i["title"] == "People using services long-term":
        for pos_i in ["Independent accommodation", "Insecure outcome"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x+0.25, y)
        for pos_i in ["Into SU", "SU L1", "SU L2"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-0.1, y)
    elif net_i["title"] == "People returning within 2y after moving to independent accommodation":
        for pos_i in ["M/F L1"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x, y+0.1)
        for pos_i in ["Independent accommodation"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-0.1, y)
        for pos_i in ["Other"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x+0.25, y)
        for pos_i in ["M L2"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-1, y)
        for pos_i in ["M L3"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-0.65, y)
        for pos_i in ["M L4"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-0.2, y)
        for pos_i in ["SU L1", "SU L2"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-0.2, y)
    elif net_i["title"] == "Men with rough sleeping support needs":
        for pos_i in ["Into M"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-0.5, y)
        for pos_i in ["Into M/F"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-1, y)
    elif net_i["title"] == "Men with support needs around risk of violence/abuse":
        for pos_i in ["Into M"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-0.5, y)
        for pos_i in ["Into M/F"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-1, y)
        for pos_i in ["M/F L1", "M/F L2", "M/F L3", "M/F L4"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x-0.5, y)
    elif (net_i["title"] == "People not returning within 6m after moving to independent accommodation"
          or net_i["title"] == "'New' people with 1 route who did not return within 6m after moving to independent accommodation"):
        for pos_i in ["Independent accommodation"]:
            x, y = pos[pos_i]
            pos[pos_i] = (x+2, y)


    into_nodes = [v for (k, v) in node_idx.items() if k.startswith("Into")]
    exit_nodes = [v for (k, v) in node_idx.items() if k in sorted_end_cats.keys()]
    node_labels = [end_n[x] if x in end_n.keys() else x for x in node_idx.keys()]
    node_label_map = {x: "Move in" for x in node_labels if x.startswith("Into")}
    colours = sns.color_palette(n_colors=len(node_idx) - len(exit_nodes) - len(into_nodes) + 1)
    colours = np.round([[x*256 for x in colour] for colour in colours]).astype("int")
    r, g, b = colours[0]
    node_colour = f"rgba({r},{g},{b},0.9)" 
    colours = [f"rgba({r},{g},{b},0.5)" for r, g, b in colours]
    grey = 'rgba(141,141,141,0.5)'
    colours.remove(grey)
    transparent = "rgba(0,0,0,0.0)"
    node_colours_map = defaultdict(lambda: "rgba(90,90,90,0.9)")
    for i in sorted(into_nodes):
        colours.insert(i, grey)
        node_colours_map[i] = grey
    for i in sorted(exit_nodes):
        colours.insert(i, transparent)
        node_colours_map[i] = grey
    node_colours = [node_colours_map[x] for x in idx_node.keys()]

    source = el_idx["source"]
    target = el_idx["target"]
    value = el_idx["n"] * 0.5
    colour = el_idx["source"].apply(lambda x: colours[x])
    label = []

    fig = go.Figure(data=[go.Sankey(
        node=dict(
          align="left",
          pad=15,
          thickness=25,
          line=dict(width=0),
          label=[node_label_map[x] if x in node_label_map.keys() else x for x in node_labels],
          color=node_colours,
          x=[(x-0.2)/5.5 for (y, x) in [pos[i] for i in node_idx]],
          y=[(y-0.1)/5 for (y, x) in [pos[i] for i in node_idx]],
        ),
        link=dict(arrowlen=10, source=source, target=target, value=value, color=colour, label=label),
        orientation="v"
    )])
    fig.update_layout(title=net_i["title"] + f" ({n_cli:,} people)", title_x=0.5, title_font_color="black",
                      font_family="Arial", font_weight=750, font_color="white", font_size=14)

    fig_filename_svg = assets_output + f"Figure_15.{fig_i}.svg"
    fig_filename_png = assets_output + f"Figure_15.{fig_i}.png"
    fig.write_image(fig_filename_svg, width=1268, height=1297)
    fig.write_image(fig_filename_png, width=1268, height=1297)
    net_i["svg"] = fig_filename_svg
    net_i["png"] = fig_filename_png

    # fig.show()
```

# Tables in an Excel file

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
sheetname = "Sheet1"
qmdfile = os.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE")
filename = assets_output + qmdfile[:-4]+".xlsx"
with pd.ExcelWriter(filename) as writer:
    next_row = 0
    for k, v in excel_output.items():
        pd.DataFrame([k]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, header=False, index=False, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += 1
        v.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += (
            (1 if not isinstance(v.columns, pd.MultiIndex) else 1 + len(v.columns.levels))
            + len(v) + 1)
    float_format = writer.book.add_format({"num_format": "#,##0.000"})
    writer.sheets[sheetname].set_column("B:J", None, float_format)
print(f"[Excel file](./{filename})")
```
